thesis: The speaker argues that the Native Americans were not necessarily taken advantage of in the Manhattan land deal because they failed to invest the $24 properly, which would have resulted in wealth exceeding the entire United States by 2026. He further illustrates the power of compounding by explaining that Queen Isabella's $30,000 funding for Columbus would have grown to exceed the entire wealth of the planet Earth by 2023 if invested at a 5% rate of return.
